recipes.name: Car Panini inspired by Family Guy
instructions: Start by draining your can of vienna sausages and setting them aside. Butter each slice of bread on 1 side and then start layering. - 1 can small of vienna sausages - Butter
Start with 1 layer of sausage, followed by Reese’s Peanut Butter Cups, some crushed Doritos and Cadbury Egg. - 4 cup Reese’s Peanut Butter - 1 bag of Doritos - 1 Cadbury Egg
Cover with the non buttered side of bread, and place on your panini press. Cook until golden brown and the chocolate has melted inside.
